378bc312b0b3.reason: The system default stays selectable: Settings always lists "System default" (value ""), and Recorder.start("") asks for {audio: true}, which is the default device. "default" and "communications" are Chrome's alias entries for a real device that is listed too; leaving them out avoids showing one microphone two or three times.

7ca5cd225cde.reason: renderSent (web/src/views/attach.ts) builds the markup with the html tagged template from core/html.ts, which escapes every interpolated value (& < > " ') before it reaches an attribute or text; the file name is also limited to 200 characters by the server. The page's Trusted Types CSP refuses any unescaped innerHTML.

bc8f56f5bc4d.reason: stopRecording catches every error and passes it to showError, and the finally block sets recording back to idle, so the button never stays stuck. The message text for a non-Error value is String(e), which is what showError shows anyway.
